analysis.summary: Artificial Intelligence is increasingly being applied across healthcare research, particularly in medical diagnosis, medical imaging and predictive analytics.
key_findings: Machine learning is widely used for healthcare prediction and classification tasks.
Deep learning has become an important approach for medical image analysis.
Explainability remains an important research challenge for clinical AI systems.
Real-world validation of research models remains limited.

evidence.claim: Explainability is an important challenge for clinical AI adoption.
evidence.paper_title: Explainable AI for Clinical Decision Support
evidence.evidence_text: The lack of model interpretability continues to create challenges for the adoption of AI-based clinical decision systems.

evidence.claim: Deep learning is widely used for medical image analysis.
evidence.paper_title: Deep Learning for Medical Image Analysis
evidence.evidence_text: Deep learning approaches have demonstrated strong performance across several medical image classification and segmentation tasks.

gaps.title: Limited Healthcare Datasets
gaps.description: Limited availability of high-quality datasets makes it difficult to develop and evaluate healthcare AI systems.

gaps.title: Model Explainability
gaps.description: Many studies focus on predictive performance while providing limited interpretability for end users.

gaps.title: Real-world Validation
gaps.description: A limited number of studies evaluate AI models in real-world clinical environments.

gaps.title: Data Privacy
gaps.description: Healthcare research requires approaches that balance AI development with patient data privacy and security.

literature_review.introduction: Artificial Intelligence has emerged as an important research area in healthcare, with applications ranging from diagnosis and medical imaging to predictive analytics.
literature_review.methodology: The literature review considers research papers related to artificial intelligence, machine learning and healthcare applications.
future_directions: Development of privacy-preserving healthcare AI systems.
